tree.config.yaml:
version: 1
paths:
  data_dir: null
  cache_dir: null
models: []
search:
  provider: auto
  fallback_chain:
    - tavily
    - brave
    - duckduckgo
  fetch_top: 3
  tavily:
    api_key: null
  brave:
    api_key: null
ethics:
  robots_enabled: false
  user_agent: YantraBot/0.1 (+https://yantra.dev)
  rate_limit:
    default:
      tokens_per_second: 1
      burst: 2
    overrides: {}
retention:
  runs_days: 30
  corrupt_index_keep: 3
agent:
  pi_auth_path: null
browser:
  source: system
  executable_path: null
